name: Bad Parenting 1: Mr Red Face VR
summary:
Step into the unsettling world of Bad Parenting 1: Mr. Red Face, a psychological VR horror experience that blurs the line between myth and reality.

For years, parents have told their children the bedtime story of Mr. Red Face—a mysterious figure said to visit late at night, leaving gifts for well-behaved kids. But in Ron’s small apartment, the legend takes a far darker turn. What begins as an innocent tale quickly unravels into a chilling nightmare as the red-faced man reveals his true intentions.
